title: Measure cluster purity
description: You label clusters by their majority species and count majority members.

steps.description: You visit each cluster and collect its assigned row indices. Empty clusters receive None in mapping and contribute no count.
You find the most frequent true label in each populated cluster. Purity divides the sum of those majority counts by the total number of rows.

steps.question: Does choosing a majority label for one cluster prevent another cluster from choosing it?
steps.answer: Each cluster chooses independently. The code imposes no one-to-one restriction on mapping.

steps.description: You print purity 0.833 for the recorded assignments. The mapping names cluster 0 versicolor, cluster 1 setosa, and cluster 2 virginica.
